messages.author: VERONICA MARTIN HERNANDEZ
messages.body:
Hi everyone
My cluster have installed AMBER 24 but, a calculation that in AMBER 22 takes 0.3h, now, in AMBER 24 takes 5 or 6 hours.
How can I fix this?
Best regards
Vero

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Feb 17, 2025, VERONICA MARTIN HERNANDEZ via AMBER wrote:
>
>My cluster have installed AMBER 24 but, a calculation that in AMBER 22
>takes 0.3h, now, in AMBER 24 takes 5 or 6 hours.
>How can I fix this?
You should start by providing some information: what program are you
running? what sort of simulation?  Is everything exactly identical except
for the executable?  Are the results of the two versions basically
equivalent, with only the timing changing?
What happens if you run a very short simulation (say 20 steps, with ntpr=1)
in parallel with the two Amber executables?  Are the mdout files the same?
....dac

messages.body:
On Tue, Feb 18, 2025, VERONICA MARTIN HERNANDEZ via AMBER wrote:
>They have recompiled CUDA and the issue was solved,
It's unclear what problem was solved: do you mean that timings (and the
actual results) for Amber24 now match what you expect?
> but we've got another error:
>
>Loading /soft/genoa/modulefiles/amber24_cuda12.2.2
>  Loading requirement: GCCcore/11.3.0 zlib/1.2.12-GCCcore-11.3.0
>    binutils/2.38-GCCcore-11.3.0 /soft/genoa/EB/modules/all/GCC/11.3.0

>Error: invalid argument launching kernel kgBuildSpecial2RestNBPreList
>
>I don't know what causes this because the administrator of the cluster says

It looks like the above error arises from some "module load" command, and
not from Amber; is that correct?  Since we have no infomation on how the
module was built, I don't think folks on this list will be able to help.
If the administrator of the cluster doesn't have this problem, the clear
step is to try to find out what you are doing that is different from what
the administrator is doing.
...good luck...dac
